groups.root_cause: Thinking events are clipped to 2,000 characters before the owner diagnostic copy is captured, so the owner copy loses the rest of the original text.
Raw owner diagnostics stay in the shared database with no protection that holds up after a rollback, so agents started by an older release can read them.
The owner_diagnostics primary key lacks AUTOINCREMENT, so IDs freed by deletion can be reused and fall behind cursors that follow logs.
Preview or build code can reach the owner-only diagnostics table through the store, and the factory copies its output into public stage summaries.
